arxiv-2106-02962.title: The THDMa revisited
arxiv-2106-02962.creator: Tania Robens
arxiv-2106-02962.description: Abstract \vskip14.22636pt Abstract The THDMa is a new physics model that extends the scalar sector of the Standard Model by an additional doublet as well as a pseudoscalar singlet and allows for mixing between all possible scalar states. In the gauge-eigenbasis, the additional pseudoscalar serves as a portal to the dark sector, with a priori any dark matter spins states.

arxiv-2302-11065.title: Probing the incompressibility of dense hadronic matter near QCD phase transition in relativistic heavy-ion collisions
arxiv-2302-11065.creator: Zhi-Min Wu 1,2, Gao-Chan Yong 1,2
arxiv-2302-11065.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zhi-Min Wu 1,2, Gao-Chan Yong 1,2. Based on the extended hadronic transport model of relativistic heavy-ion collisions, the incompressibility of dense hadronic matter created in relativistic Au+Au heavy-ion collisions at s N ​ N = 3 \sqrt{s_{NN}}=3 GeV is studied.

arxiv-2306-08157.title: Dynamic Bayesian Networks for Predicting Cryptocurrency Price Directions: Uncovering Causal Relationships
arxiv-2306-08157.creator: Rasoul Amirzadeh, Dhananjay Thiruvady, Asef Nazari, Mong Shan Ee
arxiv-2306-08157.description: Abstract Cryptocurrencies have gained popularity across various sectors, especially in finance and investment. Despite their growing popularity, cryptocurrencies can be a high-risk investment due to their price volatility. The inherent volatility in cryptocurrency prices, coupled with the effects of external global economic factors, makes predicting their price movements challenging.

arxiv-2307-00927.title: Approximation of almost diagonal non-linear maps by lattice Lipschitz operators Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2307-00927.creator: Roger Arnau, Jose M. Calabuig, Ezgi Erdoğan, Enrique A. Sánchez Pérez
arxiv-2307-00927.description: Abstract Lattice Lipschitz operators define a new class of nonlinear Banach-lattice-valued maps that can be written as diagonal functions with respect to a certain basis. In the n − n- dimensional case, such a map can be represented as a vector of size n n of real-valued functions of one variable.

arxiv-2310-15824.title: A NEW SET OF GIBBS MEASURES FOR THE SOS MODEL ON A CAYLEY TREE
arxiv-2310-15824.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . Аннотация The phase transition phenomenon is one of the central problems of statistical mechanics. It occurs when the model possesses multiple Gibbs measures. In this paper, we consider a three-state SOS (solid-on-solid) model on a Cayley tree. We reduce description of Gibbs measures to solving of a non-linear functional equation, which each solution of the equation corresponds to a Gibbs measure. We give some sufficiency conditions on the existence of multiple Gibbs measures for the model.

arxiv-2409-18318.title: Modelling cooperating failure-resilient Processes
arxiv-2409-18318.creator: Rüdiger Valk
arxiv-2409-18318.description: Abstract Cycloids are particular Petri nets for modelling processes of actions or events. They belong to the fundaments of Petri’s general systems theory and have very different interpretations, ranging from Einstein’s relativity theory and elementary information processing gates to the modelling of interacting sequential processes. The subclass of regular cycloids describes cooperating sequential processes.

arxiv-2506-13289.title: 0 ​ ν ​ β ​ β 0\nu\beta\beta decay nuclear matrix elements under Left-Right symmetric model from the spherical quasi-particle random phase approximation method with realistic force
arxiv-2506-13289.creator: Ri-Guang Huang 1,2, You-Cai Chen 3, Dong-Liang Fang 1,2
arxiv-2506-13289.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ri-Guang Huang 1,2, You-Cai Chen 3, Dong-Liang Fang 1,2. We perform the calculation of nuclear matrix elements for the neutrinoless double beta decays under a Left-Right symmetric model mediated by light neutrino, and we adopt the spherical quasi-particle random-phase approximation (QRPA) approach with realistic force. For eight nuclei: 76 Ge, 82 Se, 96 Zr, 100 Mo, 116 Cd, 128 Te, 130 Te and 136 Xe, related nuclear matrix elements are given.

arxiv-2508-21101.title: Beyond Prediction: Reinforcement Learning as the Defining Leap in Healthcare AI
arxiv-2508-21101.creator: Dilruk Perera, Gousia Habib, Qianyi Xu, Daniel J. Tan, Kai He, Erik Cambria, Mengling Feng
arxiv-2508-21101.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) marks a fundamental shift in how artificial intelligence is applied in healthcare. Instead of merely predicting outcomes, RL actively decides interventions with long term goals. Unlike traditional models that operate on fixed associations, RL systems learn through trial, feedback, and long-term reward optimization, introducing transformative possibilities and new risks.

Chi, Fernando Pereira, Wang-Cheng Kang, Derek Zhiyuan Cheng, Beidou Wang. While promising, current LLM-in-the-loop systems lack a systematic approach to managing the evolutionary process.

pmc-11389502.title: Has multimorbidity and frailty in adult hospital admissions changed over the last 15 years? A retrospective study of 107 million admissions in England
pmc-11389502.creator: Puji Faitna, Alex Bottle, Bob Klaber, Paul P Aylin
pmc-11389502.description: BackgroundFew studies have quantified multimorbidity and frailty trends within hospital settings, with even fewer reporting how much is attributable to the ageing population and individual patient factors. Studies to date have tended to focus on people over 65, rarely capturing older people or stratifying findings by planned and unplanned activity.

pmc-12605168.title: Efficacy of dietary supplements as an adjunctive therapy for polycystic ovary syndrome: an umbrella meta-analysis
pmc-12605168.creator: Rutong Wang, Kongwei Huang, Mengyao Wang, Wenhui Zou, Yujun Huang, Wei Jiang, Yingqi Feng, Huilong Shen, Xiaocan Lei
pmc-12605168.description: IntroductionPolycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) affects 5–15% of reproductive-aged women and involves significant metabolic dysregulation, for which nutritional interventions show therapeutic potential. Methods: This umbrella meta-analysis synthesizes evidence from 46 randomized trials (n = 30,133) to evaluate dietary supplements targeting core PCOS pathways.

pmc-12641159.title: Characterization of sympathicotonia in post‐covid condition (long covid) and healthy controls using long‐term electrodermal activity (EDA) follow‐up
pmc-12641159.creator: Timo Mustonen, Pasi Kytölä, Hanna Lantto, Erika Lager, Velina Vangelova‐Korpinen, Hélène Virrantaus, Aleksandra Sulg, Sanna Stålnacke, Tatiana Posharina, Ritva Luukkonen, Arja Uusitalo, Päivi Piirilä, Mari Kanerva
pmc-12641159.description: PurposeAfter SARS‐CoV‐2 infection, some patients develop post‐COVID condition (PCC), often associated with sympathicotonia. This study aimed to characterize sympathicotonia in PCC patients using a novel long‐term electrodermal activity (EDA) analysis via a smart ring and evaluate its clinical applicability.MethodsSeventeen PCC patients were recruited from a Long Covid outpatient clinic, and 18 healthy controls volunteered.

pmc-13263561.title: Comparative efficacy and safety of unilateral biportal endoscopic posterior cervical foraminotomy versus anterior cervical discectomy and fusion for single-level cervical radiculopathy: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13263561.creator: Sui-Yong Du, Bao-Quan Gao, Tao Li, Zhen Hu, Shao-Jun Liu, Hu-Bing Guo, Yu-Feng Huang
pmc-13263561.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAnterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF) is widely used for cervical radiculopathy but may limit segmental motion. Unilateral biportal endoscopy (UBE) has emerged as a minimally invasive alternative; however, comparative evidence remains limited.

pmc-13469716.title: Single-cell transcriptomics reveals anti-inflammatory effects of prednisolone on the hepatic niche in biliary atresia
pmc-13469716.creator: Paul D Blakeley, Fangran Liu, Zhongluan Wu, Clara S M Tang, Paul K H Tam, Kenneth K H Wong, Vincent C H Lui, Patrick H Y Chung
pmc-13469716.description: Biliary atresia (BA) is a life-threatening paediatric liver disease, characterized by bile duct obstruction, progressive inflammation and fibrosis. Treatment options are limited, often necessitating surgery or liver transplantation to prevent irreversible liver damage. Prednisolone has shown promise in treating BA; however, there is currently no consensus on its effectiveness, and the mechanism of action remains unknown.

(a) Reports The Commission shall, as soon as practicable after each matching payment period, submit a full report to the Senate and House of Representatives setting forth— (1) the qualified campaign expenses (shown in such detail as the Commission determines necessary) incurred.
